description: Defines the media::AudioProcessor class responsible for applying audio processing effects such as echo cancellation and noise suppression to input audio streams, utilizing WebRTC's AudioProcessing module. It includes methods for processing captured audio, analyzing playout data, managing audio processing configurations, and handling diagnostics.

classes.name: media::AudioProcessor
classes.description: Handles audio processing including echo cancellation and noise suppression, interfacing with WebRTC's AudioProcessing, managing audio formats, and providing callbacks for processed audio and logging.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate an AudioProcessor with specified callbacks, settings, and formats.

methods.name: ProcessCapturedAudio
methods.description: Processes input audio data, applies effects, and delivers processed audio via callback.

methods.name: OnPlayoutData
methods.description: Analyzes playout audio for echo cancellation and delay reporting.

methods.name: has_webrtc_audio_processing
methods.description: Checks if WebRTC audio processing is enabled.

methods.name: SetOutputWillBeMuted
methods.description: Adjusts processing complexity when audio is muted.

methods.name: GetStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics from WebRTC's AudioProcessing module.

methods.name: GetAudioProcessingModuleConfigForTesting
methods.description: Returns current APM configuration for testing purposes.

methods.name: ComputeInputFormat
methods.description: Computes a compatible input format based on device format and settings.

methods.name: GetDefaultOutputFormat
methods.description: Provides an output format optimized for minimal delay and resampling.

methods.name: needs_playout_reference
methods.description: Indicates if playout data should be referenced.
